verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal documents locations and zones for managing readers across multiple physical sites, and requires every reader to be registered to a location. That covers per-location device assignment. The Dashboard lets you configure and monitor readers, but the evidence never ties settings to a location and never mentions location-level reporting. missing for 10: evidence of per-location settings/configuration, per-location sales or transaction reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-location operation.
